folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B373: preliminary audits and later coverage
folds.body:
The original [combat](AUDIT_COMBAT.md), [cultivation](AUDIT_CULTIVATION.md), [shell](AUDIT_SHELL.md) and [household](AUDIT_HOUSEHOLD.md) audits and this full checkpoint were read together. Their early omissions and later coordinator corrections form one chronological record. The legacy combat selector, duplicated Mistglass entry captures, mistaken panel-picker conclusion, tooltip capture artifact, missing optional manifest and initial fallback fonts cannot establish current product defects. The final native shield suffix reproduction/removal, actual Mistglass learning/practice/reload, declared crafting prerequisites, paired manor/workshop views and picker-width checks are the specific later evidence recorded here, not proof of every world state or naturally earned fixture prerequisite.

Household F1 retains the concrete trade-footer geometry problem and later candidate correction; F2 retains a possible high-frequency navigation concern, qualified by its artificially all-expanded capture; F3 retains disabled-reason readability as useful design context. Native button conversion and keyboard Cancel/shared Village return do not prove Accept settlement. Connection review/cancel likewise does not prove a committed continuation transition. The source absorption ledger retains source attribution and skipped gameplay ideas as proposals in their owners, without importing new time, reward, entitlement or discovery law.

The original 56/73 represented surfaces and seventeen source-only rows are superseded for that branch by the later G1 resume's qualified 72/73 coverage. Optional worlds remains an exact absent-content limitation, not a failed native panel. Old baseline files and resume identities stay separate; the original full suite predates late fixes and G1, with focused checks scoped as recorded. These counts are historical receipts, not a renewed census. Combined integration, packaging and installed adoption have no new evidence from this reconciliation. Under current AD42, Weibao's visual/play review is optional review, so the old “remaining authoritative gates” wording cannot make human acceptance a compulsory gate. No old merge, push, installation, contact or dispatch instruction is renewed.
